title: I'm Tired Dad Cap – Minimal Embroidered White Baseball Hat
description: Soft, lived-in, and quietly honest — this classic dad cap says what your morning can’t. The low-profile, unstructured shape sits comfortably low on the brow, while the pre-curved Permacurv® visor keeps sun and glare at bay. The embroidered “I’m Tired” message reads like a wry nod to anyone juggling long days, late nights, or small humans. Lightweight 100% cotton (or 65/35 for Green Camo) breathes through stitched eyelets. An antique-brass hideaway strap lets you dial in the fit without sacrificing the cap’s clean silhouette. Wear it on slow coffee runs, bleary park walks, or when you need a little quiet signal to the world — casual, honest, and quietly relatable. Product features - Unstructured low-profile 6-panel design for a relaxed fit - Pre-curved Permacurv® visor with matching underbill - Adjustable self-fabric hideaway strap with antique brass buckle and grommet - Breathable cotton construction (Green Camo: 65% polyester / 35% cotton) with sewn-in label - Eyelets on each panel and four-row stitched visor for durability Care instructions - Use warm water and dish soap and clean spots off your hat. It's not necessary to soak the whole item. For hard to clean spots use a soft bristled brush.
